description:
Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. For someone who runs a machine, their own or a VPS rented elsewhere, and wants to sell its compute; to get a machine to use, call rent_create_sandbox instead. Changes a node's ask, capacity, region or payout. A new ask applies to leases placed from now on; running leases keep their rates. More slots or a new region sends the node back to probing. `payout` is the USDC address this node is paid to from the next payout on; the node view shows it as `payout`, null while none is registered. Change it only when the user asks, with the address the user gave. Each node is paid once a day, in USDC, to the address registered on that node; a node without an address is not paid and its releasable earnings wait until one is registered. A payout cannot be reversed, and a payout made is never sent again to another address. Changing payout needs `signed_nonce`: a nonce from GET /v1/accounts/nonce, signed with your account's agent key over the message `rent.dev payout v2
<node_id>
<nonce>
<public_key>
<network>
<address>` (six lines joined by newlines, no newline at the end). `<address>` is `payout.address` in lowercase. `<network>` is `payout.network` when you send it, else the payout network: `payouts.network` in rent_supply_earnings (while that is null, send `payout.network` and sign over it). Sign over exactly the address and network you send; a proof for another node, address or network is refused with `payout_proof_required`, and so is the old four-line message. A refusal carries `retryable`, `owner_action_required` and `next`; run `next.command` after `next.after_s` seconds, on a driver machine through npx and with its driver file, as rent_supply_guide says.

ask.description: USD per vCPU-hour and per GiB-hour, as decimal strings.

node_id.description: Node id (`n` and 15 characters) from rent_supply_nodes, or from the node kit once a node is claimed.

payout.description: Where this node's payouts go. Each node is paid once a day, in USDC, to the address registered on that node; a node without an address is not paid and its releasable earnings wait until one is registered. A payout cannot be reversed, and a payout made is never sent again to another address.

address.description: The USDC address payouts go to: 0x and 40 hex digits, lowercase or with a correct EIP-55 checksum, never the zero address.

network.description: CAIP-2 network of the address, e.g. `eip155:8453`. Leave it out for the payout network; any other is refused.
